variables.physical_definition: First-order absolute moment of surface height fluctuations (mean absolute deviation of height), a measure of average roughness height.
Peak-to-valley height (difference between highest peak and lowest valley) of the surface topography.
Root-mean-square height of surface fluctuations (standard deviation of height), a measure of roughness amplitude.
Skewness of the roughness height distribution (third standardized moment), describes asymmetry of height fluctuations.
Kurtosis of the roughness height distribution (fourth standardized moment), describes peakedness/tail weight of height fluctuations.
Effective streamwise slope of the roughness (dimensionless gradient measure of surface asperities in the flow direction).
Surface porosity (fraction of surface area occupied by voids), a dimensionless fraction between 0 and 1.
